text: Commission Guidelines on prohibited AI practices under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (C(2025) 884 final) (EU, guidance, 2025, non-binding). Provision Art. 5(1)(f) examples: An education institution using emotion recognition to infer students' interest and attention is a prohibited example (para. 255); gaze tracking that only records fixation points without inferring emotions is not prohibited (para. 255); fatigue detection for pilots/drivers is not emotion recognition (para. 249, 261). The medical exception is narrow: therapeutic use means CE-marked medical devices, general wellbeing monitoring is not covered (para. 256-257), while assisting students with autism can qualify (para. 263). Relevance to ADHD-support app: Directly maps onto attention-state monitoring; avoid institutional deployment. A wellness-claim app cannot rely on the medical exception. Tags: emotion_inference biometric children_data. Verification: verified.

text: Commission Guidelines on prohibited AI practices under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (C(2025) 884 final) (EU, guidance, 2025, non-binding). Provision Intentions; biometric limitation: Covers inference of emotions and intentions, but only on the basis of biometric data (para. 244-245, 250). Biometric data includes behavioural biometrics such as keystrokes (way of typing), eye tracking and heartbeats (para. 251); inferring emotions from written text is outside (para. 251, 265). Relevance to ADHD-support app: Gaze, HRV/EDA and keystroke dynamics are biometric; typed content sentiment is not. The guidelines do not say whether task-performance data (missed items, reaction-time variability) counts as behavioural biometrics. Tags: emotion_inference biometric children_data. Verification: verified.

text: ITU-T Y.3172 (2019) Architectural framework for machine learning in future networks including IMT-2020 (global, standard, 2019, in force). Provision Definitions/architecture: Defines ML pipeline, ML overlay, ML Function Orchestrator and ML sandbox; Supplement 96 (11/2025) lists it in force. Relevance to ADHD-support app: Pattern for separating sensing, model and intervention nodes and sandbox-testing the agent. Tags: audit_transparency. Verification: verified.
